parsed.why: Most Protective tier; statewide gender-identity public-accommodations law, hate-crime coverage, no facility ban, care shield. Residual national border/document screening and custody exposure keep it in Elevated Risk, not Reduced.

Hostile local executive order defining sex, surgery-based document rules, youth-care ban, no gender-identity hate-crime or statewide antidiscrimination coverage; documented custody harm (trans woman celled with male sex offender, claims dismissed).

Moderate-risk tier: no adult facility or care ban, but no statewide gender-identity nondiscrimination or hate-crime coverage; youth-care and school-sports restrictions via appointed boards; local ordinances cover only part of population.

Low-risk tier: gender-identity discrimination banned via regulation/commission, X markers, city sanctuary and care shield; no adult care ban. Weaknesses: no statewide hate-crime law, sports bills pending. National border/custody exposure caps score.

Youth-care ban and abrupt adult surgery cancellation in coastal city; documented fatal violence against trans women in major city under investigation. Public-employee care coverage and no facility ban partially offset. National exposures remain.
